verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              आख्याता मामकास्तात निहता युधि पाण्डवैः । हतांश्च पाण्डवेयानां मामकैर्ब्रूहि सञ्जय ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said O son, you have related which of my followers were slain in battle by the Pandavas. But now do you tell me, O Sanjaya, which of the Pandavas were slain by the warriors of my side.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              कुन्तयो युधि विक्रान्ता महासत्त्वा महाबलाः । सानुबन्धाः सहामात्या गाङ्गेयेन निपातिताः ॥२॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said All the descendants of Kunti, exerting themselves with prowess in battle and possessed of great spirit and strength, was slain by Bhishma in battle with all their kinsmen and counselors.

verses.sanskrit: नारायणा बलभद्राः शूराश्च शतशोऽपरे । अनुरक्ताश्च वीरेण भीष्मेण युधि पातिताः ॥३॥
verses.english: The Narayanas, the Vallavas, the Ramas and hundreds of others warriors, attached to the Pandavas in the field, were all slain by Bhishma in battle.

verses.sanskrit: समः किरीटिना संख्ये वीर्येण च बलेन च । सत्यजित्सत्यसन्धेन द्रोणेन निहतो युधि ॥४॥
verses.english: Satyajit, who was like Kiritin (Arjuna, decked in diadem) fighting in the field, both in prowess and strength, was slain in battle by Drona, who was of sure aim.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालानां महेष्वासाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः । द्रोणेन सह सङ्गम्य गता वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥५॥
verses.english: All the mighty bowmen among the Pandavas, who were expert in battle, departed to the region of Death, after having fought with Drona.

verses.sanskrit: तथा विराटद्रुपदौ वृद्धौ सहसुतौ नृपौ । पराक्रमन्तौ मित्रार्थे द्रोणेन निहतौ रणे ॥६॥
verses.english: So also, the old king Virata and Drupada, displaying their prowess in battle, were slain by Drona for sake of their ally, with all their sons.

verses.sanskrit: यो बाल एव समरे संमितः सव्यसाचिना । केशवेन च दुर्धर्षो बलदेवेन वा विभो ॥७॥
verses.english: O Lord that invincible hero, Abhimanyu, who, as a boy, was like Savyasachin, Keshava and Baladeva and who also was greatly skilled in battle, was surrounded by six of the most exalted of the car-warriors and slain by them, after having made an utter extermination of the enemies, when they (warriors) became incapable of withstanding Arjuna.

verses.sanskrit: परेषां कदनं कृत्वा महारथविशारदः । परिवार्य महामात्रैः षड्भिः परमकै रथैः ॥८॥
अशक्नुवद्भिर्बीभत्सुमभिमन्युर्निपातितः । कृतं तं विरथं वीरं क्षत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितम् ॥९॥
verses.english: O powerful monarch, the son of Dushasana, after having dispossessed the son of Subhadra of his car, who was still observing the duties of a Kshatriya slew him in battle.
verses.bhavadeepa: षड्भिः द्रोण-द्रौणि-शल्य-कर्ण-कृप-कृतवर्मभिः परमकै रथैः महामात्रैः मुख्यैः अशक्नुवद्भिरेकैकश्येन हन्तुमिति शेषः ॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: दौःशासनिर्महाराज सौभद्रं हतवान्रणे । सपत्नानां निहन्ता च महत्या सेनया वृतः ॥१०॥
अम्बष्ठस्य सुतः श्रीमान्मित्रहेतोः पराक्रमन् । आसाद्य लक्ष्मणं वीरं दुर्योधनसुतं रणे ॥११॥
verses.english: The handsome slayer of Patachcharas, having been encompassed by a large force, exerted himself with great prowess for the sake of his ally; and along with Ambashtha, approached heroic Lakshmana the son of Duryodhana, in battle; and also having made an immense slaughter of the enemies, repaired to the abode of Death.

verses.sanskrit: सुमहत्कदनं कृत्वा गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् । बृहन्तः सुमहेष्वासः कृतास्त्रो युद्धदुर्मदः ॥१२॥
दुःशासनेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम् । मणिमान् दण्डधारश्च राजानौ युद्धदुर्मदौ ॥१३॥
verses.english: Brihanta, that great bowman, who was well acquainted with the use of weapons and most invincible in battle, was sent to the region of Yama by Dushasana showing forth his prowess in the field.

verses.sanskrit: पराक्रमन्तौ मित्रार्थे द्रोणेन युधि पातितौ । अंशुमान् भोजराजस्तु सहसैन्यो महारथः ॥१४॥
verses.english: The two princes, Manimat and Dandadhara, who were incapable of being vanquished in battle and also who exerted themselves with prowess, were, for the sake of their friends, slain by Drona.

verses.sanskrit: भारद्वाजेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम् । सामुद्रश्चित्रसेनश्च सह पुत्रेण भारत ॥१५॥
verses.english: So also, the mighty car-warrior Ansuman, the king of the Bhojas, was dispatched to the abode of Death with his soldiers by the son of Bharadvaja, displaying his prowess in battle.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्रसेनेन वलाद्गमितो यमसादनम् । अनूपवासी नीलश्च व्याघ्रदत्तश्च वीर्यवान् ॥१६॥
verses.english: O powerful monarch, Neela, the dweller of Anupa and Vyaghradatta, endued with great prowess, both these were sent to the abode of Yama by Ashvatthaman.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वत्थाम्ना विकर्णेन गमितो यमसादनम् । चित्रायुधश्चित्रयोधी कृत्वा च कदनं महत् ॥१७॥
चित्रमार्गेण विक्रम्य विकर्णेन हतो मृधे । वृकोदरसमो युद्धे वृतः कैकेययोधिभिः ॥१८॥
verses.english: After having wrought an immense carnage, the two heroes, Chitrayudha and Chitrayodhi, were slain in battle by Vikarna, who was well acquainted with the diverse of stratagems and displayed immense prowess (in the field),

verses.sanskrit: कैकेयेन च विक्रम्य भ्राता भ्रात्रा निपातितः । जनमेजयो गदायोधी पार्वतीयः प्रतापवान् ॥१९॥
verses.english: O great monarch, that great wielder of mace, Janamejaya, the dweller of the hilly country, who was possessed of great energy, was slain by your son Durmukha.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्मुखेन महाराज तव पुत्रेण पातितः । रोचमानौ नरव्याघ्रौ रोचमानौ ग्रहाविव ॥२०॥
द्रोणेन युगपद्राजन् दिवं संप्रापितौ शरैः । नृपाश्च प्रतियुध्यन्तः पराक्रान्ता विशांपते ॥२१॥
verses.english: O monarch, the two most exalted of persons, the two brothers known by the name of Rochamana (the bright), like two bright planets, were caused by Drona with his shafts, to repair at the same time to heaven.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गता वैवस्वतक्षयम् । पुरुजित् कुन्तिभोजश्च मातुलौ सव्यसाचिनः ॥२२॥
verses.english: Having achieved the extraordinary exploits in battle. Durmarsana, Durvisaha and the great car-warrior Durjaya departed to the region of Death.

verses.sanskrit: संग्रामनिर्जिताँल्लोकान् गमितौ द्रोणसायकैः । अभिभूः काशिराजश्च काशिकैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Purujit and Kuntibhoja, the two maternal uncles of Savyasachin, were sent by the shafts of Drona to those regions that are attainable in battle.

verses.sanskrit: वसुदानस्य पुत्रेण न्यासितो देहमाहवे । अमितौजा युधामन्युरुत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् ॥२४॥
verses.english: Having been encompassed by a large number of the Kashis, Abhivus, the king of the Kashis, was caused to lay dawn his body (i.e. life) in battle by the son of Vasudana.

verses.sanskrit: निहत्य शतशः शूरानस्मदीयैर्निपातिताः । मित्रवर्माच पाञ्चाल्यः क्षत्रधर्मा च भारत ॥२५॥
verses.english: Having slaughtered hundreds of heroes, Amitaujah, Yudhamanyu and Uttamanjah endued with prowess, were all slain by our followers.

verses.sanskrit: द्रोणेन परमेष्वासौ गमितौ यमसादनम् । शिखण्डितनयो युद्धे क्षत्रदेवो युधां पतिः ॥२६॥
verses.english: O descendant of the Bharata race, the Panchala prince, Mitravarman and Kshatradharman, those mightest bowmen, were sent to the abode of Yama by Drona.

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्मणेन हतो राजंस्तव पौत्रेण भारत । सुचित्रश्चित्रवर्मा च पितापुत्रौ महारथौ ॥२७॥
verses.english: O King! In that battle, O Bharata! the foremost of warriors, son of Shikhandi Khatradeva was slain by your grandson Lakshmana.

verses.sanskrit: प्रचरन्तौ महावीरौ द्रोणेन निहतौ रणे । वार्धक्षेमिर्महाराज समुद्र इव पर्वणि ॥२८॥
verses.english: The two heroes, possessed of mighty strength, Suchitra and Chitravarman, who are related to each others as father and son, roving about in the field of battle, were slain by Drona.

verses.sanskrit: आयुधक्षयमासाद्य प्रशान्तिं परमां गतः । सेनाबिन्दुसुतः श्रेष्ठः शस्त्रवान् प्रवरो युधि ॥२९॥
verses.english: O great king, when all his weapons were exhausted, Vardhakshemi obtained in the end the superior kind of peace, even as the ocean at full tide becomes peaceful after its (superfluous) water has been drained up.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्लिकेन महाराज कौरवेन्द्रेण पातितः । धृष्टकेतुर्महाराज चेदीनां प्रवरो रथः ॥३०॥
verses.english: O monarch, having destroyed innumerable enemies in battle, Senavindu, that foremost of the Kurus, was himself slain by Balhika the great Kaurava prince,

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् । तथा सत्यधृतिर्वीरः कृत्वा कदनमाहवे ॥३१॥
verses.english: O powerful king, having achieved the most difficult feats, Dhristaketu that greatest carwarrior among the Chedis, departed to the abode of Death.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवार्थे पराक्रान्तो गमितो यमसादनम् । सेनाबिन्दुः कुरुश्रेष्ठः कृत्वा कदनमाहवे ॥३२॥
verses.english: So also, having wrought a carnage of the foes in battle for the sake of his ally, the Pandava army, heroic Satyadhriti, who was possessed of great energy, was sent to the region of Yama.

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रस्तु शिशुपालस्य सुकेतुः पृथिवीपतिः । निहत्य शात्रवान्संख्ये द्रोणेन निहतो युधि ॥३३॥
verses.english: Having slaughtered the enemies in battle, the lord of the earth Suketu, the son of Sishupala, was slain by Drona in the field.

verses.sanskrit: तथा सत्यधृतिर्वीरो मदिराश्वश्च वीर्यवान् । सूर्यदत्तश्च विक्रान्तो निहतो द्रोणसायकैः ॥३४॥
verses.english: So also, Satyadhriti the chief of the Matshyas and powerful Madirashva and Suryadatta of mighty prowess, slaughtered by the shafts of Drona.

verses.sanskrit: श्रेणिमांश्च महाराज युध्यमानः पराक्रमी । कृत्वा नसुकरं कर्म गतो वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥३५॥
verses.english: O great king, having achieved the most terrible tasks Srenimat, who was engaged in battle and possessed of mighty prowess, had gone to the abode of Death. were

verses.sanskrit: तथैव युधि विक्रान्तो मागधः परमास्त्रवित् । भीष्मेण निहतो राजञ्शेतेऽद्य परवीरहा ॥३६॥
verses.english: So also, O king, having been slain by Bhishma, the Magadha prince, that slayer of heroes on the side of the foes, who displayed his prowess in battle and was highly acquainted with the use of weapons, is now lying (in the field).

verses.sanskrit: विराटपुत्रः शङ्खस्तु उत्तरश्च महारथः । कुर्वन्तौ सुमहत्कर्म गतौ वैवस्वतक्षयम् ॥३७॥
verses.english: Having achieved the tasks most difficult to perform, the sons of Virata, Sankha and Uttara of mighty strengths departed to the abode of Death.

verses.sanskrit: वसुदानश्च कदनं कुर्वाणोऽतीव संयुगे । भारद्वाजेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम् ॥३८॥
verses.english: Having made a great slaughter in battle, Vasudana was sent to the abode of Yama, by the son of Bharadvaja careering in battle with great prowess.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च बहवः पाण्डवानां महारथाः । हता द्रोणेन विक्रम्य यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥३९॥
verses.english: These and several other mighty car-warriors among the Pandavas were slain by Drona displaying their prowess in battle. These are all that you had asked me.
